updates.change: Endplate modification
updates.how: A small revision to the rear wing endplate resulting in improved flow conditioning and aerodynamic characteristics across the full operating range.

updates.change: New floor and board
updates.how: A new floor and board featuring a modified base shape and furniture, resulting in an improvement in flow conditioning and local load generated across all conditions.

updates.change: Revised Front Corner Furniture
updates.how: A small modification to the front corner furniture resulting in an improvement in flow conditioning around the front tyre and resultant aerodynamic performance.

updates.change: Increased Brake Cooling Exit
updates.how: To meet the increased brake cooling demands of this circuit, a larger front brake cooling exit has been designed aiming at minimising the detrimental impact on aerodynamic performance.

updates.change: Revised Rear Corner Furniture
updates.how: An update to the rear corner furniture, featuring a revised winglet arrangement aiming at an efficient increase of aerodynamic load.

updates.change: Additional rear wing winglet added on centreline
updates.how: Budapest L/D.

updates.change: Wider bodywork rear exit
updates.how: Increased exit size to achieve adequate mass flow through the sidepods to ensure we have adequate cooling for this track.

updates.change: Tail winglet merged into rear wing brace.
updates.how: Running the tail winglet into the rear wing brace increases local downforce and drag at a ratio appropriate for Budapest L/D.

updates.change: Revised pylon profiles
updates.how: By exploiting the permitted rear wing pylon geometry, the camber of the pylons has been increased to extract a little more load and maintain, even enhance the flow stability.

updates.change: Revised diffuser geometry
updates.how: Having observed some competitor designs, the floor diffuser geometry has gained surface area adjacent to the rear impact structure offering a local gain in load.

updates.change: Revised flap element geometry
updates.how: Following iterations of the rear wing design, a revised flap pairing has become available for the Hungarian GP offering more load from revised camber and chord geometries. This change is accompanied by a minor revised to the lower brace (wing) geometry as part of the new design.

updates.change: New flaps design with additional trailing edge devices, re-shaped endplate top inboard volume, new pillars. Also, an optional winglet cascade in the SM fairing volume will be available
updates.how: Part of the standard development cycle, this further iteration of rear wing has been focused on

updates.change: New flaps design with additional trailing edge devices, re-shaped endplate top inboard volume, new pillars. Also, an optional winglet cascade in the SM fairing volume will be available
updates.how: winglet cascade is meant to increase rear downforce at the expense of aerodynamic efficiency, and is optional.

updates.change: A new RW assembly configuration, with a change to the rear wing flap components.
updates.how: To suit the demands of the Hungaroring circuit, we have introduced an optional rear wing flap geometry which offers an increase in downforce across the rear of the car.

updates.change: A new Floor Bodywork configuration with the introduction of new geometry on the outboard Floor Winglet.
updates.how: A further circuit specific change, which modifies the aerodynamic loading on the outboard floor body and surrounding components at the rear corner of the car.

updates.change: Addition of Roll Hoop Winglets
updates.how: The roll hoop introduced at the previous event creates additional freedom in that area. These winglets improve the quality of the airflow reaching the rear of the car.

updates.change: Updated SM pod geometry and wing auxiliary components
updates.how: A combination of changes to the SM pod and to the flaps & auxiliary components allows additional load to be generated by the rear wing, which is well suited to the circuit characteristics.

updates.change: Additional options of bodywork cooling louvres
updates.how: Opening the louvres on the bodywork allows more airflow through the radiators, increasing engine cooling and thus increasing the range of operating conditions.

updates.change: Revised front view and planview with chord redistribution.
updates.how: The front wing, endplate and nose are a package to improve the performance of the front end of the car in combination with the other car updates.

updates.change: Updated body, diveplane and foot.

updates.change: Revised lip and longer rear deflector.
updates.how: The new front brake duct external elements work alongside the new front wing to manage flow around the front wheels.

updates.change: Changes to all of the permitted surfaces of the floor.
updates.how: All floor changes are developed as a package to increase the load on the floor and therefore improve the car performance.

updates.change: Rear Wing SM Fairing optimization and new Rear Wing gurney-flap
updates.how: The revised SM Fairing increases local aerodynamic loading and, in combination with a more aggressive Gurney flap configuration, contributes to increased rear wing downforce.

updates.change: Endplate modification.
updates.how: A revised rear wing endplate profile is introduced. The update is intended to deliver a local aerodynamic load increase while contributing to the overall aerodynamic efficiency of the race car.

updates.change: Updated inlet scoop and exit aperture surfaces
updates.how: The front brake duct surfaces have been updated to increase both the inlet and exit flow areas, improving airflow through the ducts and providing additional brake cooling capacity
